name: Question generator
desc: Random questions with worked solutions. All Year 11 Advanced topics, and Year 12 differential and integral calculus.

name: LSQ generator
desc: A Low Stakes Quiz from the topics you tick, sized to the time you set, on two A4 pages. Can be linked to a homework sheet: a twin of each homework part plus review questions. Downloads as a PDF with a separate answers PDF.

name: Homework generator
desc: A weekly homework sheet, two A4 pages to print double-sided, set out like an HSC extended-response question, with past HSC questions as set or with new numbers. Downloads as a PDF with a separate sample-answers PDF, and makes the matching end-of-week LSQ.

name: Tutorial generator
desc: Hard, unfamiliar questions on Year 11 Advanced and Year 12 differential calculus, chosen to fill a 20, 25 or 30 minute tutorial. Each question has a hint and a worked solution; includes a countdown timer and prints with working space plus an answer key.
